title: Narrative theory-driven LLM methods for automatic story generation and understanding: a survey
title_zh: 基于叙事理论的LLM自动故事生成与理解综述：综述
abstract: Abstract Applications of narrative theories using large language models (LLMs) deliver promising methods in automatic story generation and understanding tasks. Our survey examines how natural language processing (NLP) research uses LLM methods to engage with diverse concepts from narrative studies. We use established distinctions from narratology to categorise ongoing efforts and discover the following: (a) narrative texts come from diverse sources beyond just literature, (b) theoretical synthesis and validation are potential outcomes, (c) generation tasks lag behind understanding in several ways: theoretical application, post-training methods, exploring non-fiction narratives and addressing narrative levels beyond fabula and discourse. For future directions, instead of the pursuit of a single, generalised benchmark for ‘narrative quality’, we believe that progress can benefit from efforts that focus on the following: defining and improving theory-based metrics for individual narrative attributes; continue conducting large-scale, theory-driven literary/social/cultural analysis; generating narratives in situated contexts; and continuing experiments where outputs can be used to validate or refine narrative theories. This work provides a contextual foundation for more systematic and theoretically informed narrative research in NLP by providing an overview to ongoing research efforts and the broader narrative studies landscape.
abstract_zh: 摘要 利用叙事理论的大型语言模型（LLM）在自动故事生成与理解任务中展现出前景。本综述考察了自然语言处理（NLP）研究如何利用LLM方法与叙事研究的多元概念互动。我们利用叙事学中的既定区分，对持续的工作进行分类，并发现了以下几点：(a) 叙事文本来源多样，而非仅限于文学作品，（b) 理论综合与验证是潜在成果，（c) 在多个方面，生成任务落后于理解任务：理论应用、训练后方法、探索非虚构叙事以及超出情节与话语的叙事层级。展望未来，我们不认为需要追求单一的“叙事质量”基准，相反，我们认为进步可从以下努力中受益：定义并改进针对个体叙事属性的基于理论的指标；继续进行大规模、基于理论的文学/社会/文化分析；在情境中生成叙事；以及继续进行输出可用于验证或完善叙事理论的实验。本工作通过概览持续的研究努力和更广阔的叙事研究领域，为更系统且具理论信息的NLP叙事研究提供了语境基础。
